title: 1335. Minimum Difficulty of a Job Schedule

examples.explanation: First day you can finish the first 5 jobs, total difficulty = 6. Second day you can finish the last job, total difficulty = 1. The difficulty of the schedule = 6 + 1 = 7
If you finish a job per day you will still have a free day. you cannot find a schedule for the given jobs.
The schedule is one job per day. total difficulty will be 3.
